subject: [hw] R2: P03 rev2 ACCEPTED (550/550); F27-F29 verified fixed
body:
Re-ran on the current tree: N2TEST P03 PASS 550/550. I read the fixes: close_opened_session() on all three post-OPEN_OK failure paths, xact() now checks the reply session centrally for typed replies (ERROR still accepted regardless because OPEN E_BUSY carries the existing id, which is correct), and the relay transport probes RWVC_INFO/abi. F27/F28/F29 are closed; F26 was already fixed.

No further P03 finding. P04's adapter uses the final header; IP keeps its own daemon/n2vcd_srv.c, so the duplicate server symbols are not a link risk as long as client/n2vcd_server.c is not also linked into vcodecd.
